Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Gary Payton II?

Gary Payton II is 33 years old.

Where was Gary Payton II born?

Gary Payton II was born in Seattle, Washington.

When was Gary Payton II born?

Gary Payton II was born on December 1, 1992.

How tall is Gary Payton II?

Gary Payton II is 6-2 (188 cm) tall.

How much does Gary Payton II weigh?

Gary Payton II weighs 195 lbs (88 kg).

Is Gary Payton II in the Hall of Fame?

Gary Payton II is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position does Gary Payton II play?

Shooting Guard, Point Guard, and Small Forward.

What is Gary Payton II's net worth?

Gary Payton II has made at least $32,369,394 playing professional basketball.

How much does Gary Payton II make?

Gary Payton II made $9,130,000 in 2025.

How many rings does Gary Payton II have?

Gary Payton II has won one championship.

What is Gary Payton II's Instagram account?

Gary Payton II is on Instagram at garydwayne.

What schools did Gary Payton II attend?

Gary Payton II attended Westwind Prep in Phoenix, Arizona and Oregon State.

What are Gary Payton II's nicknames?

The Mitten, Young Glove are nicknames for Gary Payton II.
